_meta.method: Every URL below was fetched during this survey unless marked 'not fetched'. Navigated from official home pages.
_meta.tls_note: www.bank-of-algeria.dz and www.tunisieclearing.com serve incomplete certificate chains. Verification was kept on: the missing intermediates (DigiCert Global G2 TLS RSA SHA256 2020 CA1, Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA DV R36) were downloaded from the issuers' AIA URLs and appended to the proxy CA bundle (certs/bundle.pem).

sources.name: CBN government securities JSON API: NTB primary auctions
sources.terms_of_use: not found (CBN homepage has no terms/disclaimer link, and /disclaimer.html returned 404)
sources.notes: Best source in the survey. No ISIN, no bid count. Amounts look like NGN millions for NTB (e.g. amtOffered 100000.0000). Dates are strings like 'September-23-2026'. trueYield is 0.0000 on recent records.

sources.name: CBN JSON API: FGN Bond
sources.cadence: monthly; this feed appears STALE after 2023-06
sources.notes: Use the DMO PDFs for FGN bonds after 2023.

sources.name: CBN JSON API: OMO
sources.notes: These are CBN bills, not sovereign debt. Units are inconsistent: recent OMO amounts are in full naira (5e11), older ones in millions.

sources.name: DMO FGN Bond auction results
sources.format: HTML listing (Joomla, 20 per page, ~12 pages) -> text PDF via /<id>-<slug>/file
sources.history_oldest: 2008-01 ('Summary of Auction Result for January 2008', last listing page limitstart=220)
sources.terms_of_use: 'Copyright © 2026 Debt Management Office Nigeria. All Rights Reserved.' (footer, https://www.dmo.gov.ng/). No terms-of-use page found, only a /privacy notice.
sources.notes: No ISIN. Each listing item has an RSS feed (?format=rss). The DMO also publishes daily Eurobond closing price and yield files on its homepage (e.g. /6090-nigeria-s-eurobonds-closing-prices-...-/file; format not opened).

sources.name: DMO Nigerian Treasury Bills listing
sources.notes: STALE since March 2021. Use the CBN NTB API instead.

sources.name: NGX bonds price list (exchange)
sources.terms_of_use: 'The Data Agreement and Policy document set out the terms and conditions under which persons or entities receiving NGX Market Data may use and/or disseminate it.' (https://ngxgroup.com/exchange/data/data-pricing-policies-contracts/). Redistribution appears to need a licence; the agreement document was not read.
sources.notes: Most listed bonds show no trades. FMDQ (fmdqgroup.com) homepage fetched but no machine-readable quotation link found; not pursued.

sources.name: BoG treasury bill rates table (wpDataTables)
sources.api: POST https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=get_wdtable&table_id=2 (needs the wdtNonce scraped from the page)
fields_available: Security Type (91/182/364-day bills, 1-2Y notes, 3-15Y FXR bonds)
sources.notes: Rates only, no amounts. The AJAX endpoint is internal and its nonce rotates.

sources.name: BoG weekly GoG T-bill auction results
sources.history_oldest: only ~12 most recent tenders visible (from 2026-07-10). /page/N/ returns the same list, so the archive could not be browsed
fields_available: bid rates allotted in full (discount and interest)
weighted average discount and interest rate
sources.terms_of_use: 'The information on this site is provided for general reference purposes only. Whilst every effort is made to ensure that the site is up-to-date and accurate, the Bank of Ghana does not guarantee, nor does it accept any responsibility or liability for, the accuracy or completeness of the content...' (https://www.bog.gov.gh/disclaimer/). Footer: '© 2026 Bank of Ghana. All rights reserved.' No explicit reuse clause.
sources.notes: Also /bog_auction_results/ (BoG bills, central bank paper). Ghana bond auctions (MoF) not surveyed.

sources.name: GSE / GFIM
sources.format: page content not machine-readable in static HTML
sources.notes: gse.com.gh links to http://gfim.com.gh/ (not fetched). Not usable without more work.

sources.name: Bank Al-Maghrib: Résultats des émissions de bons du Trésor
sources.format: HTML table + CSV export (';' separator, decimal comma, UTF-8)
sources.terms_of_use: 'Le droit d'auteur sur le présent site Web et tous les documents qui y sont contenus appartient à Bank Al-Maghrib. La reproduction, en totalité ou en partie du présent site Web est interdite. Les utilisateurs sont tenus de se conformer aux conditions de réutilisation des données et statistiques de la Banque intégrées au niveau de la Charte de Bank Al-Maghrib sur la diffusion des données et statistiques.' (https://www.bkam.ma/Trouvez-l-information-concernant/Mentions-legales). The Charte was not read.
sources.notes: No ISIN and no bid count. A date with no auction returns 'Aucun enregistrement trouvé'. BKAM also runs a free developer API portal (https://apihelpdesk.centralbankofmorocco.ma, free API key needed; catalogue not checked). Also available: 'Taux de référence des bons du Trésor' (secondary yield curve) at /Marches/.../Marche-secondaire/Taux-de-reference-des-bons-du-tresor (not fetched).

sources.name: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (DTFE) communiqués
sources.fields_available: treasury cash placements and 'Cotation électronique des BDT (E-Bond Maroc)' communiqués. No auction-result PDF seen on the first page
sources.notes: BKAM is the better source for auction results.

sources.name: Bourse de Casablanca
sources.notes: No bond price list found in the static HTML. Not pursued.

sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt
sources.status: 200 with body 'Request Rejected' (WAF); a deep URL returned 403
sources.notes: The origin WAF blocks this UA, even with browser Accept headers. Not a proxy denial (proxy status shows no failures). The CBE auction pages could not be confirmed.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance: Treasury Bills posts (API behind the React SPA)
sources.format: JSON; each post's content.raw is an HTML table
sources.cadence: per auction, with gaps (387 posts since 2020)
sources.notes: No amounts offered or accepted and no ISIN. The table layout varies over time (needs a robust HTML-table parser). The API endpoint was found in the site JS (main.82fbec15.chunk.js) and is undocumented. EGX (www.egx.com.eg) returned an empty reply.

sources.terms_of_use: not found on the MoF page
sources.notes: Usable only for 2007-2018 history. /fr/les-indicateurs/marche-secondaire fetched (no PDF/XLS links in static HTML).

sources.name: Tunisie Clearing
sources.notes: The current BTA/BTCT results most likely live here, but the site is client-rendered and no public API path was found in the bundle. Unconfirmed.

sources.name: Banque d'Algérie
sources.notes: No treasury auction results found. 'Statistiques du marché' covers the interbank, FX and liquidity markets. The Ministry of Finance (https://www.mf.gov.dz/) returned HTTP 500.

sources.name: Bourse d'Alger (SGBV): OAT trading history
sources.history_oldest: at least 2026-01-06 on the default view
sources.notes: Secondary-market OAT trades. Not auction results. /?page=oat lists the listed OATs (not fetched).

sources.name: Central Bank of The Gambia: Auction Results
sources.format: HTML table + XLSX/PDF per auction date
sources.history_oldest: 2017-11-29 (383 dates in the selector; the oldest XLSX downloaded OK)
sources.terms_of_use: Footer only: 'Copyright © 2026. All Rights Reserved.' No terms page found.
sources.notes: Clean and easy to ingest. The XLSX title has a typo ('Aunction'). /bonds and /central-bank-bills pages exist (not fetched).

sources.name: Bank of Sierra Leone: Treasury Bills Auction
sources.status: 200 (www.bsl.gov.sl gives proxy CONNECT 502; use the bare domain)
sources.format: static HTML list -> text PDFs ('Announcement  DD MM YYYY.pdf')
fields_available: next week's offer (issue date, maturity date, amount)
sources.terms_of_use: 'Users of the Bank of Sierra Leone website are free to make personal use of the information obtained directly therefrom... Any other use of the information, other than merely for personal consultation, is authorised only if the following terms and conditions are observed and complied with: Any distribution or reproduction of information disseminated on the Bank of Sierra Leone website shall be carried out faithfully, without any ...' (https://bsl.gov.sl/Disclaimer.html)
sources.notes: File names contain double spaces and irregular suffixes. The 2026 auction calendar PDF is on the homepage.

sources.name: CBL publications: Treasury Bills
sources.notes: Government T-bill results stop in 2015 here. /publications/document-type/central-bank-liberia-bills has weekly 'CBL Bills Issuance Report' PDFs up to 2026-07-31 (central bank paper, not sovereign). The MFDP site was not checked.

sources.name: BCC: Bons du Trésor avis au public / Taux des bons du Trésor
sources.format: Next.js HTML (data embedded) -> text PDFs on resources.bcc.cd
fields_available: per-bid table (bank, account, amount, yield, price)
sources.terms_of_use: 'La reproduction ou la diffusion de ces contenus est autorisée à des fins d'information, d'étude ou de recherche, sous réserve de citer la source « Banque Centrale du Congo » ainsi que, le cas échéant, la date de publication. Toute utilisation des contenus du site à des fins mercantiles ou commerciales est interdite.' (https://www.bcc.cd/mentions-legales)
sources.notes: WARNING: the per-bid table names individual investors (personal data). Ingest only the summary fields. Commercial use is prohibited. '/politique-monetaire/adjudications-resultats/<date>' (326 entries, 2016-03-21 to 2025-11-12) are FX auctions (ABD), not T-bills (sample COD_bcc_FX_auction_ABD_2025-11-12.pdf). 'Bons BCC' (central bank bills) are published up to July 2026.
